economy.summary: Her platform calls for supporting local businesses through responsible economic development, workforce development and job training, expanding access to grants and technical assistance, and strengthening local business districts.
economy.short: Supports workforce training, business grants, strengthening local business districts.

abortion.summary: Lists protecting reproductive freedom as a priority under a platform section on expanding policies that support women and families.
abortion.short: Lists protecting reproductive freedom as a priority.

education.summary: Her platform calls for securing fair and adequate school funding, supporting teachers and school staff, expanding student mental health supports, strengthening special education services, and investing in modern school buildings.
education.short: Calls for fair school funding, staff support, special education.

healthcare.summary: Lists access to healthcare and essential community services among vital services she would protect, and supports expanding mental health and crisis intervention services.
healthcare.short: Supports protecting healthcare access, expanding mental health services.

energy.summary: Her platform lists protecting clean air and clean water, preserving open space, addressing climate change through smart policy, reducing plastic waste, and improving stormwater management.
energy.short: Supports clean air and water, addressing climate change, reducing waste.

guns.summary: Her public safety platform calls for providing police and first responders with training and modern equipment, community-based crime prevention, expanded crisis intervention, and advancing stalled anti-hate crime legislation; it does not detail a firearms-specific position.
guns.short: Public safety platform: police training, crime prevention; no firearms specifics.

economy.summary: His platform calls for creating good-paying jobs, supporting small businesses, and ensuring working families can make ends meet.
economy.short: Supports creating jobs, small businesses, helping working families.

taxes.summary: Calls for lower property taxes and responsible spending, proposing to expand the senior Property Tax/Rent Rebate, enact longtime-owner-occupant assessment caps, increase the homestead exclusion, freeze rates for low-income seniors, and create a volunteer tax credit program.
taxes.short: Proposes lowering property taxes via rebates, caps, senior freezes.

education.summary: Says he is committed to protecting parental rights in education and would strengthen the Educational Improvement Tax Credit (EITC).
education.short: Supports parental rights and strengthening the EITC program.

healthcare.summary: As a health insurance broker, he says he would cut through red tape, fight for transparency, and drive down health insurance premiums for Pennsylvania families.
healthcare.short: Pledges to increase transparency and drive down insurance premiums.

guns.summary: His public safety platform says he is committed to backing law enforcement officers with funding, training, and community support; it does not detail a firearms-specific position.
guns.short: Backs law enforcement funding and training; no firearms specifics.
